corpusLayout.redundancy: Pedestrian scenarios (C5) and workzone scenarios (C8) are most over-represented, with additional concentration in occlusion (C7); several variants appear to explore similar visibility and intrusion patterns.
corpusLayout.reasoning: Four of the 15 taxonomy categories are entirely uncovered, including intersections, roundabouts, vehicle-control events, and cyclists/PTWs. The 92 attempted briefs are therefore distributed unevenly across a corpus dominated by pedestrian, workzone, and occlusion cases. This imbalance and the absence of entire behavioral domains make the corpus unsuitable as a sufficiently representative training set without additional coverage and deduplication.
